result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: one major layout truncation issue, one major content anomaly, and one minor clipping concern.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is abruptly cut off in the 'Fastest near you' carousel. There is no ellipsis (...) to indicate the text continues, making it appear broken rather than intentionally truncated.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis with overflow: hidden and a fixed width to the restaurant name element so truncation is visually communicated properly.

issues.description: The discount badge on the bottom pizza restaurant card shows '-100%', which is an unusual and likely erroneous value. This could indicate a data rendering bug where a promo code or discount value is being incorrectly calculated or displayed.
issues.suggestion: Validate the discount calculation logic on the backend and add frontend guardrails to cap or flag discount values that exceed realistic thresholds (e.g., >99%) before rendering.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel is partially clipped with no visual affordance (e.g., a fade gradient or partial shadow) to indicate it is scrollable. Users may not realize additional restaurants are available.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-side fade/gradient overlay to the carousel to signal horizontal scrollability, improving discoverability of additional content.
